summary: A change between two texts, one column or side by side, with the changed words marked and long unchanged runs folded away.

props.name: filename
props.description: The file's name in the header.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: One column with removed lines over added ones, or the two sides next to each other.

props.name: context
props.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change; longer runs fold behind a button.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the frame. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
